title: Beal Level 26 Foundations v24.2.0: Logarithmic Form Upper Bound on Gap-3 Solutions
description: Branch v24-matveev-log-form-bound from v24.1.1 21df092 / 10.5281/zenodo.22730846. Extends BealMatveevThm14.lean by establishing the upper bound side of the logarithmic linear form on gap-3 solutions: on A^4 + B^4 = (B+3)^13, B > 0 via baker_le_B0_gap3 (matveev_gap3_B_pos_of_solution), A > 0 via eq_implies_A_gt_B (matveev_gap3_A_pos), Lambda = 4 log A - 13 log (B+3) < 0 and |Lambda| = -Lambda = -(4 log A - 13 log (B+3)) (matveev_gap3_log_form_upper_bound), and 0 < matveev_target_exp_lower < 1 (matveev_exp_lower_lt_one_and_pos). Keeps all v24.0.0 through v24.1.1 lemmas. Links the upper bound side to the lower bound target. Target and baker_bound_gap3 stay uninhabited def Prop (Mathlib 4.12 has no Matveev 2000 Thm 1.4).
